_comment: SafeZones config. Player names are stored as lowercase.
_comment_houseBlockedItemIds: Blacklist: these item IDs cannot be placed in house cells (H). Empty = everything allowed.
_comment_mobEnterWhitelistNpcTypeIds: Whitelist: these NPC type ids (role names) may spawn in SafeZones and are not repelled by denyMobEnter. Example: ["MobTeleporter"]
_comment_placeDistance: Placement distance rules. Newly placed blocks/items listed here must be at least <distance> blocks away from the SafeZone outer border. Max distance is 4. Example: [{"itemId":"*Workbenches_Crafting_Bench","distance":2}]
_comment_benchRadius: Optional override for Hytale CraftingConfig bench container search. If unset/empty, server defaults apply. horizontal/vertical: 0..7, limit: 0..200.
_comment_claimLimits: Claim limits. globalPerPlayer: max HOUSE-claims a player may own across all zones (0=unlimited). perZone: optional per-zone limits by zone id; global limit still applies.
_comment_eventTitle: Timing (seconds) for the SafeZones enter title. duration=-1 means 'very long' (mapped to 99999).
_comment_waterPlacement: Inside SafeZones, water placement is denied everywhere except for plot owners within [groundY+minOffset .. groundY+maxOffset]. Offsets are blocks.
_comment_defaults_build_mine: canBuild/canMine control block place and break; F-key pickup from ground uses the same decision as break (canMine). allowItemPickup is for picking up dropped items. Reload or restart after changes.
